body.x: SoSo (President Dong-Bin Min, www.soso-g.co.kr) presented BRAINNO, a wearable 2-channel, brain wave device, and T-Coach, a completely user-customized healthcare application, at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.

BRAINNO aids a person to play a game by utilizing only his or her brain waves. The device is a type of BIC (Brain Computer Interface) which analyzes the electric signal from a person’s brain instantly and controls the electronic equipment.

Based on measuring brain waves from left and right lobes with a speed of 256 signals per second, this device assesses the status of left-right brain balance development and minimizes the noise input. The performance of this device stands up to that of a medical equipment and can be used for IoT, SmartHome, healthcare, e-learning, and game interface.

Also presented at this show was T-Coach, an application that recommends the matching brain wave games and applications for concentration enhancement or stress relief based on the person’s brain activity. The company explains that improving concentration and reducing stress through these games may prevent conditions such as ADHD, PTSD, and dementia.

The company’s spokesperson stated, "While there are many companies that manufacture devices like this, we are the only one in the world that has both the device and content. Furthermore, the company is currently in contact with a major American telecommunication company that has been showing interest and is also negotiating with China to export the product."

In addition to domestic sales, SoSo utilized BCI technology and is already supplying Brain King and Brain Training System to Japan and other countries from 2013. Brain King is a children's brain developer and Brain Training System is a learning performance enhancer.
